/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/shoulde.description: The Shoulder Twirl is a single shoulder wheel on a post, finished in Ocean Grey. The user stands facing the wheel, takes the handle and turns it in slow, wide circles, first one way and then the other. It moves the shoulder through its full range, which helps people with stiff shoulders and office workers who sit for long hours. The single version suits a small open gym or a spot beside a walking path where only one machine will fit. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range, and its twin-wheel version is the Shoulder Twirl Double. Sales can share the exact size and warranty cover on request. The Shoulder Twirl warranty will be confirmed in your quote; standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/shoulde.spec_paragraph: The wheel turns on a bearing at its hub, which should run smoothly and quietly; grease it when it starts to drag. A single-post machine like this is often fixed self-standing on a firm slab. Leave standing room in front of the wheel and keep the path behind the user clear.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/ski-tra.description: The Ski Trainer copies the movement of cross-country skiing. The user stands on two orange footplates, holds the handles and slides the legs forward and back in opposite directions while the arms push and pull. It works the legs, arms and core together and raises the heart rate without any impact on the joints. It suits regular walkers and joggers who want a harder cardio station in a park, and it is popular in college and corporate open gyms. The Ski Trainer is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. We will confirm cover in your quote, based on our standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/ski-tra.spec_paragraph: Both footplate arms swing on bearings, which take steady wear on a busy track. Check and grease them on a set schedule. The Ski Trainer is installed self-standing or grouted after we see your ground. Leave space in front of and behind the footplates for the full stride.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/standin.description: The Standing Twister Single is a one-person waist twister. The user stands on a round orange footplate, holds the orange handle wheel and turns the hips left and right while the upper body stays still. It is a simple warm-up and mobility machine that people of almost any age can use, including older residents who want to keep the lower back supple. A single twister takes very little ground, so it is easy to add to an existing walking track or society garden. It comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. For the Standing Twister Single, our standard warranty of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in writing.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/standin.spec_paragraph: The footplate turns on a bearing under the user's full weight, so check it for wobble and grease it regularly. This small machine is normally installed self-standing on a firm base. Keep the footplate dry and free of grit, which can make it slippery after rain.
flags: SKU FFE018 is the base code used by the 1 Seating Cum 2 Standing Twister (FFE018D). Check the SKU scheme.
No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/step-tr.description: The Step Trainer is a stair-climbing machine with two orange foot pedals. The user holds the handles and presses each pedal down in turn, as if climbing steps, which works the thighs, calves and hips and gets the heart going. The pace is set by the user, so it suits both fitter adults and people building up their stamina. Housing societies in high-rise buildings often like it, because it gives the stair-climbing workout without using the building's stairwell. The Step Trainer belongs to our Fun Fitness range and is finished in Play Orange. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. Standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, which we will confirm with your quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/step-tr.spec_paragraph: The pedals move up and down on pivots, and those pivots are where wear shows first. Inspect them and the pedal surfaces at each service. We install the Step Trainer self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground. Keep the pedals clear of mud so feet do not slip.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/tai-chi.description: The Tai Chi Cum Standing Twister joins two standing stations. On one side, the user turns a pair of tai chi spinner wheels with both hands in slow circles, which loosens the shoulders and upper back. On the other side, a standing twister turns the hips and waist. Together they give a gentle routine for the upper and lower body that older residents can do in a few minutes after their walk. This combination is part of our Fun Fitness range, and its listed colour is Play Orange. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. On the Tai Chi Cum Standing Twister, we will confirm cover in the quote; our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/tai-chi.spec_paragraph: The spinner wheels and the twister platform all run on bearings, so check each one for free movement at every service visit. The frame is fixed self-standing or grouted. Place it so the two users face away from each other and neither stands in a walkway.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/tai-chi.description: The Tai Chi Double has two sets of orange hand wheels on one frame, so two people can do tai chi arm circles side by side. Each user stands, grips the handles and turns the wheels in slow circles, together or in opposite directions. The movement works the shoulders, arms and wrists and is easy on the joints, which is why it is popular with senior citizens' groups in parks and society gardens. Our Fun Fitness range lists the Tai Chi Double in Play Orange. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. For the Tai Chi Double, our standard warranty terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in writing. Ask us for a layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/tai-chi.spec_paragraph: Four wheels mean four bearings to check, and a stiff wheel is the usual sign one needs grease. The double frame is installed self-standing or grouted. Give each user enough standing room in front of their wheels, and keep the area level.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/tai-chi.description: The Tai Chi is our single-user spinner, with two orange hand wheels set on a frame at chest height. The user stands facing the wheels and turns them in slow circles, which loosens the shoulders, upper back and wrists. It needs no strength to start and is often the first machine older users try in a new open gym. Because it is small, it fits beside a bench along a walking track or in a corner of a society garden. Play Orange is the listed finish for the single Tai Chi in our Fun Fitness range. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, which we will confirm with your quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/tai-chi.spec_paragraph: Each wheel runs on its own bearing, so turn both by hand at each maintenance visit and grease any that feel rough. This compact unit is usually installed self-standing on a firm slab. Keep the standing area in front of the wheels dry and even.
flags: SKU FFE015 is also used for the Leg Lift Post. Duplicate SKU.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/twister.description: The Twister Three Way is a standing waist twister for three people, with orange footplates around a central handle wheel. Each user stands on a plate, holds the wheel and turns the hips from side to side. With three stations on one post, it handles the morning rush on a busy park track and lets small groups exercise together. It complements the Seating Twister Three Way, which is the seated version for users who prefer to sit. The three-way twister sits in our Fun Fitness range with a Play Orange finish. Neither the size nor a warranty line is listed. For the Twister Three Way, our standard warranty of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in the quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/twister.spec_paragraph: Three footplates share one post, so the base should be grouted on most grounds. Each plate has its own bearing to check and grease. Leave a clear ring around the machine so people waiting do not stand where a turning plate can catch them.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/garden-decor/atypical-bin.htm.description: The Atypical Bin is an outdoor dustbin with wooden slats around the body, held on a black steel stand. The slatted finish lets it sit next to our benches and gazebos without looking out of place, which matters in a landscaped society garden, a resort lawn or a corporate campus. Raising the bin on a stand keeps it off wet ground and makes it easier to empty. It belongs to the garden decor part of our CoreCraft range, and the listed colour is Sand Beige. We share its size, capacity and warranty terms with your quote. If you are planning a full play or gym area, we can mark bin positions on the same layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/atypical-bin.htm.spec_paragraph: The Atypical Bin's steel stand can be bolted self-standing or grouted, so it cannot be tipped over or moved. Place bins near benches and entrances rather than inside the safe play area. Empty them regularly in the monsoon so rainwater does not collect inside.

/corecraft/garden-decor/bastion-bench.ht.description: The Bastion Bench is a park bench with wooden slats on a black steel frame. The plain lines of the frame suit modern housing societies and corporate campuses, where it can line a walking path or sit at the edge of a play area for parents. Benches placed near a play zone let parents and grandparents watch children from outside the safe play area, which is where we usually show them on a layout. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range, and the listed colour is Sand Beige. We share the length, seating capacity and warranty terms of the Bastion Bench with your quote. We will confirm those details with your quote and can mark bench positions on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/bastion-bench.ht.spec_paragraph: Bastion Bench legs are fixed self-standing on a slab or grouted into the ground, so the bench cannot be dragged into a play zone. Check the slat fixings and frame bolts during routine maintenance, and clear leaves from between the slats so water drains away.

/corecraft/garden-decor/comfy-gazebo.htm.description: The Comfy Gazebo is a wooden garden gazebo with an eight-sided base, a sloped roof, railings around the sides and coloured window panels under the roof edge. The side view shows seating inside, so it works as a shaded sitting area in a park, a resort lawn or a society garden. Placed near a play area, it gives parents a place out of the sun while they watch their children. It is part of our CoreCraft garden decor range, which also includes the Repose Gazebo and two pergola designs. The listed colour is Sand Beige. Size, seating capacity and warranty terms come with the quote. Ask us to place the Comfy Gazebo on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/comfy-gazebo.htm.spec_paragraph: A gazebo needs a level, well-drained base, and we usually grout it so it stays fixed in strong wind. The roof and posts should be checked for loose fixings after the monsoon. Keep gutters and the floor clear of leaves, and recoat exposed wood as part of regular upkeep.

/corecraft/garden-decor/crevice-cube.htm.description: Crevice Cube is a set of cube-shaped seats, each sitting on a black steel base, with tops in blue, yellow, teal and red. The blocks can be spaced out in a row or a cluster as informal seating. Children like to hop between them, and adults can sit on them. They suit school courtyards, society gardens, mall forecourts and the edges of a play area. Crevice Cube belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range. The listing gives the colour as Sand Beige, though the photos show coloured tops, so tell us which finish you want. We confirm the block size, the number of blocks in a set and the warranty in the quote.
/corecraft/garden-decor/crevice-cube.htm.spec_paragraph: Each Crevice Cube block stands on its own steel base, fixed self-standing or grouted so it cannot be moved. Space the blocks so there is a clear walking gap between them. Check the base fixings during maintenance and wipe the tops after rain.

/corecraft/garden-decor/curve-bench.html.description: The Curve Bench has a curved seat of wooden slats on black steel legs. The curve lets it follow the edge of a round lawn, a fountain or a circular play area, and people sitting on it face slightly towards each other, which suits conversation. It works well around a merry-go-round or a multi play station, where parents sit just outside the safe play area. Sand Beige is the listed colour for this CoreCraft garden decor bench. Ask us for its length, radius, seating capacity and warranty terms. We will confirm these with the quote, and several Curve Benches can be combined into a larger ring on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/garden-decor/curve-bench.html.spec_paragraph: Curve Bench legs are fixed self-standing on a paved base or grouted into soil. If you are placing several in a ring, we set them out on site against the layout drawing. Check the slat screws and leg bolts during maintenance and keep the gaps between slats clear.
